title: Dominic and the Visitor
author: Gideon Ashgrove
blurb: Rafael Ishikawa, a radio host taking calls from listeners who died last week, has spent twenty years telling themselves the noises have explanations. But when the excavation crew unearths a door, sealed from the inside, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must return what was taken in 1974 before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
